draft.emotion: surprised and pleased that something happened sooner than expected
notes: With a present-tense verb and a time period, 'al' expresses how long something has been going on (English uses 'have been ... for').
As a determiner before a word like 'de', 'het', or 'mijn', 'al' means 'all' (e.g., 'al het water' — all the water).
